messages:
marta: Starting canary rollout for v2026.03.1 -> eu-west. 10% traffic. Please watch SLOs (p95 latency, 5xx) for embeddings and serve routes. Release notes: https://internal.releases/redwood/v2026.03.1 — if errors jump >=2% or p95 increases >50ms we hold/pin.

deploy-bot: Deploy started: canary-id=canary-3301, release=v2026.03.1, region=eu-west, traffic=10%
```./deploy canary --release v2026.03.1 --region eu-west --traffic 10%```

kevin: noted. i'll watch embed-route dash. ping me if error rate >1.5% or sustained p95 >250ms :eyes:

ashley: quick readout from dashboards — small p95 uptick on `embeds/v1` (~+22ms), error rate steady at ~0.9%. seeing a few transient 502s from proxy-2 around 10:12am UTC. snapshot: p50=32ms, p95=235ms, p99=412ms, errors=0.9%

priya: can you post the heatmap link? not seeing obvious kv-cache correlation yet. also run a small traces query: `service:proxy AND upstream_reset` for the timeframe.

ashley: heatmap https://dashboards/re/redwood/embeds-heatmap?panel=3 — tailing logs now. quick log sample:
```
2026-02-14T10:12:03Z proxy-2 upstream_reset: conn reset by peer id=proxy-2 code=ECONNRESET trace=trace-9f3a
2026-02-14T10:12:07Z proxy-2 upstream_502 id=proxy-2 target=embed-serve-01
```

kevin: if errors hit 2% we pin back to v2026.02.9. i'll be ready to coordinate rollback via deploy-bot.

deploy-bot: Autoscaler event: added +1 instance to canary pool (reason: queue_latency > 200ms).

marta: Hold any traffic increases for now. provisioning churn on autoscaler can transiently spike latency/429s — ashley, can you keep tailing proxy-2 logs? priya, start a short traces span for `trace-9f3a` and related IDs.

ashley: tail shows repeated `upstream reset` lines and a burst of connection retries. sample detail: ```upstream_reset: conn reset by peer at 2026-02-14T10:12:03Z (retries=3)```

priya: recommending we keep canary at 10% and monitor for 15 more minutes. rollback condition: p95 > 300ms OR 5xx > 2% sustained for >5m. agree?

kevin: :thumbsup: agree. i'll trigger pin/rollback if thresholds are met. posting in #eng-oncall if it looks like escalation.

marta: FYI i've muted the noisy kvcache fluctuation alert for 10m while we observe to avoid alert fatigue: `/mute alert kvcache-fluctuation 10m`

sre-bot: Alert muted: kvcache-fluctuation (muted by marta) — expires in 10 minutes.

deploy-bot: Canary status update (6m): traffic=10%, p95=235ms, errors=1.1%, instances=+1. No automatic rollback triggered.

kevin: watching. no rollback yet.

marta: I'll add a note to the release notes about proxy-2 transient resets and our mitigation steps. If anyone sees a sustained deviation, ping me directly and we'll pin.

(ended: ongoing watch — will update thread with any threshold crossings)
